about: Hand-written rotation guides for the mage's player pages (guides.py). Rewritten 2026-11-04 on the 2026-11-02 patch data (client 70753): the lists the pages show that day, the full-raid casts and damage shares of the simulator's environments runs, and the fight lab's 2026-11-04 signature audit (300 fights a level). Leveling guides revised 2026-11-15 for the new Arcane, Arcane-Frost and Fire orders and the re-tuned Fire and Frostfire rules.

raid.plan: Frost in a raid builds **Winter's Chill** on the boss with **Frostbolt** and spends it with **Cone of Cold**: every Frostbolt adds a stack, and at five stacks Cone of Cold deals twice its damage plus 35% of your spell damage, a quarter of the build's damage from one cast about every 15 seconds. **Ice Lance** takes the second charge of each **Fingers of Frost** proc, **Ice Barrier** keeps Frigid Power up, and **Cold Snap** buys one more Cone of Cold a fight. Cone of Cold is a cone in front of you: stand within 10 yards of the boss and face it (behind it, with the melee). 796 DPS in a full raid. This is the official simulator's own Frost build and list (wowsims/forever's Frost preset), which the page starts from since 2026-11-20.
why: **Frostbolt** is the base: 60 casts and 66% of the damage, at rank 10, the trainer's top rank. **Improved Frostbolt** takes its cast to 2.5 seconds, **Ice Shards** doubles its critical bonus and **Precision** adds 6% hit. With 5 points in **Winter's Chill** every Frostbolt that hits puts a stack on the boss: 20% more damage from your next **Cone of Cold** and 7% of your spell damage added to it, up to 5 stacks.

**Cone of Cold** at five stacks (12 casts, 25% of the damage): twice its damage and 35% of your spell damage on top, and **Improved Cone of Cold** adds 35%. Its 10-second cooldown is shorter than five Frostbolts, so the list waits for the stacks, not for the cooldown. **Arctic Reach** stretches its reach by 20%.

**Ice Lance** on the last charge of **Fingers of Frost** (6 casts, 8.5%): each chill has a 15% chance to give you two charges that make your next spells count as cast on a frozen target, which **Shatter** turns into 50% more critical chance. The first charge goes to a Frostbolt; the instant Ice Lance takes the second and adds a Winter's Chill stack of its own.
**Ice Barrier** before the pull and whenever Frigid Power has under 3 seconds left (4 casts): 15% more Frost damage for a minute, and 5% more while the shield holds.

**Cold Snap** once a fight, when **Cone of Cold** still has 7 seconds or more of its cooldown left: it ends every other Frost cooldown, so one more five-stack Cone. It also resets **Ice Block**, which this build takes.
caveats: Range: **Cone of Cold** reaches 10 yards in front of you (12 with **Arctic Reach**). Where you cannot stand that close or face the boss, it goes: cast **Frostbolt** instead, and the **Winter's Chill** points add nothing. The simulator's fights stand you at 10 yards.

Our search's 17/2/32 (under Other builds) is 0.4% ahead in the same fights, under the 0.5% bar, and about 2% ahead in the Raid BiS set that was chosen for its talents (818 against 802), so the gear table shows it there. Which build is better gear by gear is settled in a later pass, each in a set made for it.
Threat: this build has no **Frost Channeling**, so your Frost spells keep their full threat; **Arcane Subtlety** lowers Arcane threat only.
Mana: below 5% the list uses your mana gem and channels **Evocation**. With a raid's mana buffs a 3-minute fight never gets there; a long fight does.
Several targets: **Blizzard**, and **Cone of Cold** hits everything in the cone. The simulator's fights are one boss.
diverge: If you cannot stand within 10 yards of the boss: **Frostbolt** in place of **Cone of Cold**.
Keep **Cold Snap** for a second **Ice Block** on a fight that needs one.
When raid damage breaks the shield, recast **Ice Barrier** as soon as its 30-second cooldown allows: the extra 5% lasts only while the shield holds.

leveling.plan: Frost levels by slowing, freezing and shattering: **Frostbolt** slows the mob as it walks in, **Frost Nova** freezes it when it arrives, you step back, and **Ice Lance** hits the frozen target for four times its damage with **Shatter**'s crit chance; from 40 **Ice Barrier** goes up before each pull. Frost points first (**Ice Lance** at 20, **Shatter** complete by 29, **Fingers of Frost** at 30-31, **Cold Snap** at 37, **Ice Barrier** at 40 and **Improved Frost Nova**'s second point at 41), then the Arcane mana talents from 42 (**Arcane Concentration** by 54, **Arcane Meditation** at 58-60), with one point in **Incineration** (57). In the 20-60 race of the redo of 2026-11-21 (your own regeneration running while you eat and drink) this build takes about 26.9 seconds per kill, level-weighted, within the noise of the Arcane page's build (26.3) and the Arcane-Frost page's (26.9). The page's numbers table has each level.
why: **Frostbolt** from as far away as you can and whenever nothing else applies, while the mob has more than a tenth of its health (a fifth before the re-tune of 2026-11-20): 2.5 seconds with **Improved Frostbolt** at 5 points, 290 mana at top rank less **Frost Channeling**'s 15%, and a 40% slow for 9 seconds that buys extra casts before the mob reaches you (**Permafrost** lengthens it). From 30 every chill has a 15% chance to light up **Fingers of Frost** (your next 2 spells count as cast on a frozen target), and from 33 **Frostbite** freezes the mob on the same roll: the fight lab rolls the two together. If the mob would reach you before the cast ends and **Frost Nova** is ready, wand it until it arrives; if it is already on you with **Frost Nova** down, keep casting.

**Frost Nova** when it reaches you, then step back out of melee: it freezes the mob for up to 8 seconds (damage can break it), and out of reach it cannot hit you or push your casts back. **Improved Frost Nova** takes 4 seconds off its 25-second cooldown.

**Ice Lance** into the freeze whenever it is ready: it deals 300% more damage to a frozen target, crits 50% more often there with **Shatter**, and crits for double with **Ice Shards**. It has an 8-second cooldown, so you get one per freeze, not a stream. In the open search's talent values at level 60 (2026-11-20), taking out **Ice Lance** costs about 3.4 seconds per kill, **Shatter** 3.3, **Ice Barrier** 2.5, **Fingers of Frost** 2.4, **Ice Shards** 1.8 and **Improved Frostbolt** 1.5.

**Fire Blast** is the finish and nothing else: the tuned rules cast it only while the mob is between a tenth and a fifth of its health, when it will kill or the mob is on you, and since 2026-11-20 they keep **Frostbolt** going down to a tenth (a fifth before). Below a tenth an **Ice Lance** that will kill, or the wand, finishes cheaper than a long cast. It is not the answer to a mob that reaches you with health to spare. **Fire Blast** and **Ice Lance** share one cooldown, and **Incineration** (one point) adds 2% crit to both.

The Arcane points are for mana: **Arcane Concentration** gives a 10% chance after a damage spell hits that your next one is free, and **Arcane Meditation** (which needs all 5 **Arcane Concentration** points) keeps another half of your regeneration going while you cast, all of it with **Mage Armor** (about 1.5 seconds per kill at 60 in the open search of 2026-11-20). **Wand Specialization** makes the finishing wand hits 25% stronger.
**Counterspell** (level 24) a mob that casts spells: it stops the cast and locks that school for 10 seconds.
caveats: This build takes **Cold Snap** (37) and **Ice Barrier** (40): from 40, **Ice Barrier** before each pull whenever it is ready, and again mid-fight when its minute of extra Frost damage runs out, as the fight lab plays it. **Frostbite** (33, 36) and **Winter's Chill** (38-39) fill the Frost tree to the 30 points **Ice Barrier** needs: **Winter's Chill** does nothing in a list without **Cone of Cold**, and **Frostbite**'s second point measured nothing (its 10% is under the 15% of **Fingers of Frost**, and the fight lab rolls the two together).

This is the open leveling search's 19/0/32 winner of 2026-11-20, 1.7% faster per kill at levels 20-60 than the hand-made Frost build under Other builds. The leveling filler passes of 2026-11-20 and 2026-11-21 moved eight points that measured nothing or only held a tier open (Ice Block, Arcane Wrath, Arcane Blast, a point each of **Precision**, **Winter's Chill** and **Missile Barrage**, two of **Permafrost**) to **Improved Frost Nova**, **Frostbite**, **Arctic Reach**, **Incineration**, **Arcane Resilience** and **Magic Absorption**.
**Cone of Cold** stays out of single pulls: the tuned rules switch it off (kills measured faster without).

Drink below 15% of your mana (the tuned rule); **Evocation** in place of that drink, whenever it is ready (under 15% mana); eat below 40% of your health (the tuned rules). Whenever you sit down to drink or eat, do both while the other bar is not full: it costs no extra time (the tuned rules of 2026-11-17).

Armor: **Mage Armor** from 34 (the tuned rules of 2026-11-15). It keeps half your mana regeneration going while you cast, so you drink less: 4-5% faster per kill at 34-40 in the fight lab, 2-3% at 46-50, 1.4-2.5% at 56-60, though you eat a little more without armor. Before 34, **Frost Armor** and **Ice Armor** chill a mob that hits you, and from 30 that chill can light up **Fingers of Frost**; **Mage Armor** does not.

Pulls of several mobs are a different game: the AoE build under Other builds gathers about four, freezes them with **Frost Nova** and uses **Blizzard** and **Cone of Cold**, in **Ice Armor** (in pulls of four, Mage Armor measured 9-20% slower per kill, with more deaths).
diverge: If **Frost Nova** is on cooldown when the mob arrives, **Cold Snap** (from 37) resets it when it has more than 8 seconds left and the mob still has 40% of its health; otherwise keep casting **Frostbolt**.
Low on mana in a fight: let an **Ice Lance** into the freeze or the wand finish a nearly dead mob rather than start a **Frostbolt**.

raid.plan: Arcane-Frost is an Arcane list with a **Frostbolt** filler: keep two stacks of your **Arcane Blast** buff up, **Arcane Wrath** whenever it is ready, a free **Arcane Missiles** on every **Missile Barrage** proc, and **Frostbolt** in every gap, which rolls for the proc too. There is no cooldown to press: the build takes neither Presence of Mind nor Arcane Power. 692 DPS in a full raid, in its own entry (arcane-frost-raid, the rotation its search tuned), 16% behind the Arcane page.
why: **Arcane Missiles** on **Missile Barrage** comes first: 14 casts and 29% of the damage. **Arcane Blast** gives a 40% chance per cast, **Arcane Wrath** and **Frostbolt** 20% each, so with three sources the proc is up often; it makes the next Missiles free, 2.5 seconds long and twice as dense. **Arcane Impact** adds 6% crit, **Arcane Mind** doubles the crit bonus of your Arcane spells, and **Arcane Instability** adds 3% damage and 3% crit to everything.

**Arcane Blast**, 24 casts and 16%: keep its buff stacked on you. Each cast gives you 12% of your Intellect as spell damage for 18 seconds, stacking to 4, and adds 100% to its mana cost per stack; the list casts it when the buff is missing or about to run out and until it has 2 stacks, then lets **Frostbolt** fill. Adding that line was the raid search's biggest gain for this entry (+6.1%).

**Arcane Wrath** whenever it is ready (14 casts, 25%): 3 seconds with **Accelerant**, a 6-second cooldown, 406-496 damage plus 5% of your maximum mana as spell damage, and its own **Missile Barrage** roll. The list stops it with 20 seconds left: late casts and their flight time overrun the fight (+0.4% in the search).

**Frostbolt** fills everything else (26 casts, 29%): 2.5 seconds with **Improved Frostbolt**, 260 mana at rank 10, the trainer's top rank, **Precision**'s 6% hit, **Ice Shards**' doubled crit bonus, and a 20% **Missile Barrage** roll of its own. The Frost half ends at **Ice Shards**: this build has no Ice Lance, Shatter or Fingers of Frost.
**Fire Blast** only in the last 3 seconds, when a **Frostbolt** would land too late; **Incineration** gives it 10% crit.

Mana: your mana gem (from **Conjure Mana Ruby**) below 80% mana, a mana potion, **Arcane Concentration** at 4 points (8% free casts) and **Magic Absorption** (2% of your mana back for each spell you fully resist). With a raid's buffs the simulator almost never needed **Evocation** here (one fight in 3,000); its line fires below 20% mana with more than 25 seconds left.
caveats: The Arcane page's build (the official simulator's Arcane Fire, since 2026-11-20) is the same Arcane core with Arcane's cooldowns and a Fire half: it takes Presence of Mind, Arcane Power, Pyroblast and Heating Up, casts **Fire Blast** on cooldown and a 1.5-second Pyroblast at three Heating Up stacks: 826 against 692. This page exists because the hybrid split is its own spec on these pages.
Several targets: **Arcane Explosion**, **Blizzard** and **Cone of Cold**; the simulator fights one boss.
Moving: **Fire Blast** is your only instant. Threat: **Arcane Subtlety** cuts Arcane threat by 30%; the simulator ignores threat.
diverge: In the last 20 seconds no **Arcane Wrath**; in the last 3 seconds **Fire Blast** instead of a **Frostbolt**.
Without raid mana buffs, the simulator's list for playing alone channels **Evocation** only below 5% mana while more than 50 seconds remain; later, the mana comes back too late to spend.

leveling.plan: This hybrid plays the Frost list with one Arcane addition: **Frostbolt** at range, **Frost Nova** and a step back when the mob arrives, **Ice Lance** into the freeze, and a free, fast **Arcane Missiles** whenever **Missile Barrage** lights up. Its Frost points come first (**Ice Lance** at 20, **Shatter** complete by 28), then Arcane from 29 (**Wand Specialization**, **Arcane Resilience**, **Improved Channeling**, **Missile Barrage** complete at 35), **Arctic Reach**'s second point at 36 (its first is at 26) and **Fingers of Frost** at 37-38, then Arcane to 60 (**Arcane Concentration** by 46, **Arcane Meditation** by 50, **Presence of Mind** at 53, **Arcane Mind** at 54-56, **Arcane Resilience**'s second point at 57, **Arcane Instability** at 58-60) with **Frost Channeling**'s third point at 42. In the 20-60 race of the redo of 2026-11-21 (your own regeneration running while you eat and drink) it takes about 26.9 seconds per kill level-weighted: a tie within the noise with the Frost page's build (26.9) and the Arcane page's (26.3). The page's numbers table has each level.
why: **Frostbolt** from as far away as you can and as the filler while the mob has more than a tenth of its health (a fifth before the re-tune of 2026-11-20): its slow buys casts before the mob arrives, its chill rolls **Frostbite** (one point: 5% to freeze the mob) and, from 37, **Fingers of Frost** (15%: the next 2 spells count as cast on a frozen target; the fight lab rolls the two together, so that 15% also freezes), and with **Missile Barrage** each one has a 20% chance to light up a free **Arcane Missiles**. If the mob would reach you before the cast ends and **Frost Nova** is ready, wand it until it arrives; if it is on you with **Frost Nova** down, keep casting.

**Arcane Missiles** only on a **Missile Barrage** proc: half the channel (2.5 seconds), no mana, missiles every half second. Cast it at range or into a freeze, not while the mob is hitting you unless it is frozen: hits can cut the channel short; **Improved Channeling** (4 of 5 points by level 51) gives each hit an 80% chance to cost no time. Taking out **Missile Barrage** costs about 2.4 seconds per kill at 60 in the open search of 2026-11-20.

**Frost Nova** when the mob reaches you, then step back; **Ice Lance** while it is frozen: 300% more damage to a frozen target, 50% more crit chance from **Shatter** and bigger crits from **Ice Shards**. **Ice Lance** has an 8-second cooldown, one per freeze. In the open search of 2026-11-20, taking out **Shatter** costs about 2.6 seconds per kill at 60, **Improved Frostbolt** 2.1, **Ice Lance** 1.9 and **Fingers of Frost** 1.1.

**Fire Blast** is the finish and nothing else: the tuned rules cast it only while the mob is between a tenth and a fifth of its health, when it will kill or the mob is on you, and since 2026-11-20 they keep **Frostbolt** going down to a tenth (a fifth before). Below a tenth an **Ice Lance** that will kill, or the wand, finishes it. It is not the answer to a mob that reaches you with health to spare.

The rest of the Arcane half is mana: **Arcane Concentration** gives a 10% chance after a damage spell hits that your next one is free, and **Arcane Meditation** keeps another half of your regeneration going while you cast (all of it with **Mage Armor**); **Wand Specialization** makes the finishing wand hits 25% stronger. **Presence of Mind** (level 53) makes one cast instant every 3 minutes: the fight lab opens a pull with an instant **Frostbolt**. The last seven points: **Arcane Mind** (54-56) 6% more Intellect, a second **Arcane Resilience** point (57) for armor, **Arcane Instability** (58-60) 3% more spell damage and crit. The tuned rules drink only below 15% of your mana and eat below 40% of your health.
caveats: This build takes no Cold Snap: skip that part of the list. Until **Missile Barrage** at 34 it plays as a plain Frost mage, and its **Fingers of Frost** comes only at 37.
**Cone of Cold** stays out of single pulls: the tuned rules switch it off (kills measured faster without).

Rest: drink below 15% of your mana, **Evocation** in place of that drink when it is ready (under 15% mana), eat below 40% of your health. Whenever you sit down to drink or eat, do both while the other bar is not full: it costs no extra time (the tuned rules of 2026-11-17).

Armor: **Mage Armor** from 34 (the tuned rules of 2026-11-15): it keeps half your mana regeneration going while you cast, about 4% faster per kill at 34-40 and 2% at 46 in the fight lab. From 50, with **Arcane Meditation** complete, the two armors are even (within about 1%): wear either.

This is the open leveling search's 29/0/22 winner of 2026-11-20, 1.7% faster per kill at levels 20-60 than the build it replaced. The leveling filler pass of the same day moved Arcane Geometry and an **Ice Shards** point to **Frost Channeling** (42 and 23). Arcane Blast is not in this build: skip any line for it.
diverge: On a nearly dead mob, skip even a free **Arcane Missiles**: an **Ice Lance** or **Fire Blast** that will kill, or the wand.
Mob on you with **Frost Nova** down: keep casting **Frostbolt**; the list uses **Fire Blast** only in the mob's last fifth, and never **Cone of Cold**.

raid.plan: Arcane with a Fire filler: **Fire Blast** on every cooldown and **Pyroblast** whenever three **Heating Up** stacks make it a 1.5-second cast, between the Arcane spells: **Arcane Missiles** on every **Missile Barrage** proc, **Arcane Blast** kept at three stacks of its buff, and **Arcane Wrath**. 826 DPS in a full raid. This is the official simulator's own Arcane build and list (its Arcane Fire preset), which the page starts from since 2026-11-20; our own Arcane build (under Other builds) is 0.4% behind in the same fights.
why: **Pyroblast** first, at three **Heating Up** stacks (10-11 casts, 17.5% of the damage): every Fire Blast hit and every critical Fire Blast or Scorch adds a stack, each taking 25% off its cast. **Ignite** adds 40% of each Fire critical strike over 4 seconds (4%).

**Fire Blast** whenever it is ready (28 casts, 20%): a 6-second cooldown with **Improved Fire Blast**, an instant that feeds Heating Up. **Incineration** adds 10% critical chance to it, to **Arcane Blast** and to **Scorch**.

**Arcane Missiles** on **Missile Barrage** (12-13 casts, 24%): **Arcane Blast** procs it 40% of the time and **Arcane Wrath** 20%, and the proc makes the next Missiles free and twice as fast. Rank 7 is your top rank.

**Arcane Blast** to three stacks of its buff (34 casts, 19%): each cast gives you 12% of your Intellect as spell damage for 18 seconds and doubles the next one's mana cost. The list keeps three up and casts a fourth only while your mana is above a share that falls as the fight goes on.

**Arcane Wrath** whenever it is ready (8 casts, 13%), the first one made instant by **Presence of Mind**: it gains 5% of your maximum mana as spell damage. **Arcane Power** goes out with a Missile Barrage proc or Arcane Wrath.
**Scorch** is the filler when your mana is short (3 casts).
caveats: Mana: the list spends fast. Below 10% it uses your mana gem and channels **Evocation**; a fight longer than 3 minutes needs them.
Moving: **Fire Blast** is instant and **Presence of Mind** makes one cast instant; the rest needs you to stand.
Threat: **Arcane Subtlety** cuts Arcane threat by 30%; the Fire spells keep theirs.
Several targets: **Arcane Explosion** and **Flamestrike**. The simulator's fights are one boss.
diverge: When mana runs short before the end, stop at three **Arcane Blast** stacks and fill with **Scorch**, as the list does below its mana line.
In a fight longer than 3 minutes, use **Arcane Power** and **Presence of Mind** again when they are back.

leveling.plan: Arcane levels on its own spells: **Arcane Wrath** to open (from 25), two **Arcane Blast** stacks while the mob walks in, then **Arcane Missiles**, which you keep channeling when the mob reaches you; **Frost Nova** and a step back when it arrives. The page's order takes Arcane first (**Arcane Blast** at 20, **Missile Barrage** at 21-22, **Presence of Mind** at 30, **Arcane Power** at 42) with two Frost points for hit at 38-39, and puts the other 16 Frost points last, from 45. In the 20-60 race of the redo of 2026-11-21 (your own regeneration running while you eat and drink) it takes about 26.3 seconds per kill level-weighted, the fastest of the mage leveling pages, within the noise of the Frost page's build (26.9) and the Arcane-Frost page's (26.9). The page's numbers table has each level.
why: **Presence of Mind** (level 30) at the pull makes your first cast instant (the opening **Arcane Wrath** in the fight lab). From level 42 **Arcane Power** goes at the pull too, whenever it is ready and you have more than half your mana: 15 seconds of 30% more spell damage at 30% more mana cost.

**Arcane Wrath** opens when its cast (3.5 seconds) lands before the mob arrives, then goes out whenever it is ready (6-second cooldown) and the cast fits. It gains spell damage equal to 5% of your maximum mana, and each cast has a 20% chance to light up **Missile Barrage**.

**Arcane Blast** twice while the mob walks in: each cast gives you 12% of your Intellect as spell damage for 18 seconds and doubles the next cast's cost, so the fight lab stops at two and starts one only while it costs at most a quarter of your mana and will finish before the mob reaches you. Each cast rolls 40% for **Missile Barrage**. Taking out **Arcane Blast** costs about 2.3 seconds per kill at 60 in the open search of 2026-11-20.

**Arcane Missiles** is the main spell, at range and in melee: **Improved Channeling** at 5 points gives a 100% chance that hits do not interrupt the channel (70% for **Arcane Blast** and **Arcane Wrath**). **Missile Barrage** makes the next one free, 2.5 seconds long and twice as dense: cast it at once after your two stacks, or when the mob is on you. In the open search of 2026-11-20, taking out **Missile Barrage** costs about 3.6 seconds per kill at 60 and **Improved Channeling** 1.9, then **Arcane Meditation** (1.4), **Shatter** (1.3), **Arcane Mind** (1.2), **Arcane Concentration** (1.1) and **Precision** (1.1).

**Frost Nova** is in the list: when the mob reaches you and has more than about a tenth of its health, freeze it and step back, then keep channeling. The tuned rules (2026-11-06) hold back only **Cone of Cold**: it is cast just when the mob is on you, **Frost Nova** is down and the mob is below a fifth of its health.

**Fire Blast** finishes a mob it will kill, and when you cannot afford **Arcane Missiles** it is the instant for a mob on you, else **Frostbolt**. The 18 Frost points: **Precision** (38-39) for hit, then **Improved Frostbolt** (45-47), **Ice Shards** (48, 51-52 and 54), **Improved Frost Nova** (49-50), **Ice Lance** (53), **Frost Channeling** (55), **Frost Warding** (56) and **Frostbite** (57), which only open **Shatter**'s row, and **Shatter** (58-60). Only **Frost Nova** freezes the mob in this build (**Frostbite** needs a chill this list almost never casts); in the open search of 2026-11-20 **Ice Lance** into the freeze is worth about 0.6 seconds per kill at 60 and **Shatter** 1.3.
caveats: This build takes **Ice Lance** only at level 53: before that, skip its line of the list.

Mana: **Arcane Missiles** costs 655 at top rank, every **Arcane Blast** stack makes the next one dearer. **Frostbolt** (290) is for when you cannot afford the Missiles. The tuned rules of 2026-11-15 drink below 15% of your mana, eat below 40% of your health and wear **Mage Armor** from 34 (with **Arcane Meditation** it keeps all of your regeneration going while you cast: 4% faster per kill at 34 in the fight lab, 0-1% from 40); use **Evocation** between fights in place of a drink, when it is ready and you are under 15% mana. Whenever you sit down to drink or eat, do both while the other bar is not full: it costs no extra time (the tuned rules of 2026-11-17).
Single pulls only: with several mobs on you, **Frost Nova** and **Arcane Explosion** are back in play.

This is the open leveling search's 33/0/18 winner of 2026-11-15, 1.6% faster per kill at levels 20-60 than the 31/0/20 build it replaced: two points moved from **Ice Shards** to **Arcane Subtlety**, **Arcane Power** at 42 instead of 59 and **Ice Lance** at 53 instead of 50; the search of 2026-11-20 found no faster build. The leveling filler passes since then moved the points that measured nothing or only held a tier open; since 2026-11-22 they sit in **Arcane Resilience** (10, back from Wand Specialization: 0.2-0.4% faster per kill), **Ice Shards** (51, 52, 54), **Frost Channeling** (55), **Frost Warding** (56) and **Frostbite** (57).
diverge: If the mob would reach you before an **Arcane Blast** or **Arcane Wrath** finishes, do not start it: channel **Arcane Missiles** instead (an instant cast with **Presence of Mind** is the exception).
A mob that hits harder than a normal same-level mob is worth a **Frost Nova** even when it is nearly dead: the rule that skips it only reflects the mobs the fight lab models.
Against a caster mob, **Counterspell** it when it starts a cast, as every mage list in the fight lab does.

raid.plan: Fire keeps its own **Improved Scorch** debuff at 5 stacks, fires **Fire Blast** every 6 seconds, casts **Pyroblast** whenever three crits have made it a 1.5-second cast, keeps one stack of its **Arcane Blast** buff up, spends **Missile Barrage** procs on free **Arcane Missiles**, and fills with **Fireball** or **Scorch**. The best mage page in the simulator: 869 DPS in a full raid.
why: **Pyroblast** at 3 stacks of **Heating Up** is the first spell on the list (14 casts, 25%; its crits also feed **Ignite**, 10%): crits from **Fireball**, **Fire Blast** and **Scorch** each cut its 6-second cast by 25%, and **Fire Blast** adds a stack on every hit, so three stacks come about every 13 seconds and the cast takes 1.5 seconds. One hard cast before the pull lands as the fight starts.

**Fire Blast** on cooldown (29 casts, 21%): every 6 seconds with **Improved Fire Blast**, instant, 10% crit from **Incineration** and 6% from **Critical Mass**; its crits start **Ignite** (40% of the hit over 4 seconds) and every hit feeds **Heating Up**.

**Scorch** keeps Fire Vulnerability at 5 stacks (**Improved Scorch**: 3% more Fire damage per stack for 30 seconds) and refreshes it under 5 seconds left. It is also the short filler (23 casts in all, 11%): when **Fire Blast** will be back before a 3-second **Fireball** could land, the list casts a 1.5-second **Scorch** instead.

**Fire Power** is why the burns matter: 3% more Fire damage per Fire effect of yours on the target, up to 12%, and Fire Vulnerability, **Ignite**, **Pyroblast**'s burn and **Fireball**'s burn are four. **Fireball** (18 casts, 20%) casts in 3 seconds with all five points of **Accelerant**; the list names rank 11 (rank 12 comes from a tome).

The 17 Arcane points: one **Arcane Blast** about every 20 seconds (9 casts, 4%) keeps its buff on you (12% of your Intellect as spell damage for 18 seconds) and rolls 40% for **Missile Barrage**, which **Fireball** rolls at 20%; the proc's free, fast **Arcane Missiles** are 9% of the damage (6 casts). **Arcane Concentration** makes one cast in ten free.

**Combustion** once Fire Vulnerability has 5 stacks (the list holds every cooldown until then; one a fight on its 3-minute cooldown): each Fire hit adds 10% Fire crit until you land 3 crits, which fills **Heating Up** fast.

Mana: a mana potion whenever it is ready (2 a fight, the list's top line), your mana gem (from **Conjure Mana Ruby**) and a Demonic Rune (about one each), and **Master of Elements**' 20% refund on every Fire crit. The raid list no longer channels **Evocation**: the search dropped that line on 2026-11-10 (+0.4%). Without a raid's mana buffs the simulator's DPS falls 23% from a 3-minute to a 6-minute fight: the mana runs out.
caveats: Mana without a raid's buffs: the simulator's list for playing alone adds **Evocation** below 10% mana with more than 25 seconds left.
Several targets: **Flamestrike** (this build has no Blast Wave); **Fire Blast** hits one target only.
Fire resistance: the simulator's boss resists nothing. Against a target that resists Fire, **Frostbolt** is your fallback and most of this list loses value.
Threat: this build skips Burning Soul, so only **Arcane Subtlety** lowers your threat, and only for the Arcane spells; the simulator ignores threat.
diverge: In the last 3 seconds a **Fireball** would land too late: **Scorch** or **Fire Blast**.
Moving: **Fire Blast** and the 1.5-second **Scorch** keep the stacks and **Heating Up** going; **Pyroblast** and **Fireball** wait.

The list has no 2-stack **Pyroblast** line (the simulator's own Fire rotation, which this list is built on, dropped it): with 2 stacks and the boss about to die, a **Scorch** and a **Fire Blast** in the same 3 seconds are its choice.

leveling.plan: Fire levels with **Fireball** at range and **Fire Blast** up close, opens every pull from level 20 with a hard-cast **Pyroblast**, and borrows the Frost tree's freeze: **Frost Nova**, a step back, and **Ice Lance** into the frozen mob; **Heating Up** (level 25) shortens later **Pyroblast** casts enough to fit some into a freeze. The page's order is **Accelerant** and **Ignite** to 19, **Pyroblast** at 20, then the Fire tree from 21 to 41 (**Improved Fire Blast**, **Burning Soul**, **Heating Up** at 25, **Master of Elements**, **Critical Mass**, **Incineration**, **Fire Power**, **Combustion** at 40), then 18 Frost points and one Arcane point from 42 to 60 (**Ice Lance** at 52, **Shatter** by 59, **Wand Specialization** at 60): the open search's own-tree-first order, 1.5% / 1.3% faster per kill at levels 20-60 on two seeds than the order with the Frost points first (5% faster at 30, 8% at 40, 6% slower at 50; 2026-11-23). In the 20-60 race of the redo of 2026-11-21 (your own regeneration running while you eat and drink) it takes about 32.8 seconds per kill level-weighted, the slowest of the mage leveling pages, about 25% behind the Arcane page's build (26.3). The page's numbers table has each level.
why: The 18 Frost points: **Precision** (hit), **Frost Warding**, **Improved Frost Nova** (**Frost Nova** back 4 seconds sooner), **Ice Shards**, **Ice Lance**, **Frost Channeling** (Frost spells 10% cheaper) and **Shatter**; since the open search of 2026-11-17 no Frostbite, so only **Frost Nova** freezes the mob. A frozen mob takes 300% more damage from **Ice Lance**, which crits 50% more often there with **Shatter** and for double with **Ice Shards**; **Ice Lance** has an 8-second cooldown, one per freeze, and shares it with **Fire Blast**. In the open search of 2026-11-20, taking out **Shatter** costs about 3.1 seconds per kill at 60 and **Ice Lance** 2.2.

**Fireball** from as far away as you can, and as the filler whenever nothing else applies, while the mob has more than about a third (35%) of its health and you have more than 15% of your mana. Below that health the tuned rules (2026-11-15) start no **Fireball** or **Pyroblast**: a long cast overkills. Under 15% mana they start no **Fireball** either: **Fire Blast** and the wand end the fight, and you drink after it (the drink rule is 15% too). **Accelerant** takes half a second off its cast at 5 points.

**Pyroblast** opens every pull (a tuned rule that makes the Fire signature spell part of every fight): a 6-second cast the mob runs in during, so finish it and go on. Since the tune of 2026-11-20 it goes out again whenever its whole cast will end before the mob can hit you, and at once at 3 stacks of **Heating Up**, both only while the mob has more than a third of its health. A 6-second cast rarely fits; from 25 one or two **Heating Up** stacks (4.5 or 3 seconds) make it fit into a **Frost Nova** freeze.

**Fire Blast** is your instant: when the mob would reach you before a **Fireball** lands, when it is on you and **Frost Nova** is down, to finish a mob it will kill, and whenever it is ready once the rules start no **Fireball** (the mob's last third, or under 15% of your mana). **Improved Fire Blast** takes 1 second off its 8-second cooldown at 21 and 2 from 22, **Critical Mass** and **Incineration** (10% on **Fire Blast** and **Ice Lance** at 5 points) add crit, and every hit adds a **Heating Up** stack. A **Fire Blast** puts **Ice Lance** on cooldown too, and the other way round.

**Heating Up**: crits with **Fireball**, **Fire Blast** and **Scorch**, and every **Fire Blast** hit, each cut your next **Pyroblast**'s cast by 25%, up to 3 stacks. At 3 stacks its 6-second cast takes 1.5 seconds. On one mob the 3 stacks rarely come together before it dies; one or two already let a **Pyroblast** fit into a freeze, and the opener stays the main one.

**Frost Nova** when the mob reaches you with more than about a tenth of its health left, at any mana: the rules of 2026-11-15 dropped the old floor of 30% of your mana. Then step back; **Ice Lance** while it is frozen; with **Frost Nova** down, **Fire Blast** and keep casting. The tuned rules never cast **Scorch**.

**Ignite** (40% of every crit's damage over 4 seconds), **Master of Elements** (30% of the base cost back on every Fire or Frost crit) and **Fire Power** (up to 12% more Fire damage with several Fire effects on the mob) are the Fire tree's passive half. **Combustion** goes at the pull once you have it at level 40.
caveats: This build has no Ice Block: a pull that goes wrong is **Blink**, **Mana Shield** or a healing potion.

Mana: **Fireball** costs 410 at top rank against 290 for a **Frostbolt**. Drink below 15% of your mana and eat below 80% of your health (the tuned rules; 80% since 2026-11-20); use **Evocation** between fights in place of a drink, when it is ready and you are under 15% mana. Whenever you sit down to drink or eat, do both while the other bar is not full: it costs no extra time (the tuned rules of 2026-11-17).

Armor: **Mage Armor** from 34, as on the other mage leveling pages: the tune of 2026-11-17, once you eat while you drink, found it about 1.2% faster per kill. The rules of 2026-11-15 had kept **Ice Armor** to 60 (Mage Armor was no faster then).
Pulls of several mobs: **Flamestrike** hits them all, but the fight lab only measured single pulls for Fire.

This is the open leveling search's 1/32/18 winner of 2026-11-20, 0.7% faster per kill at levels 20-60 than the build it replaced. The leveling filler pass of the same day moved two points that measured nothing or only held a tier open, Improved Scorch and Improved Fire Ward, to **Burning Soul** (26 since the order of 2026-11-23) and **Improved Fire Blast** (22); **Precision**'s third point measured nothing too, and stays because it holds **Ice Shards**' row open.
diverge: On a nearly dead mob (below about a third), finish with an instant that will kill (**Fire Blast**, an **Ice Lance** into a freeze) or the wand rather than start a **Fireball**.

raid.plan: Frostfire is a Fire list whose main spell is **Frostfire Bolt**: it counts as both Fire and Frost, so both trees' talents apply, its chill rolls **Fingers of Frost**, and its crits stack **Heating Up** for a 1.5-second **Pyroblast**. **Scorch** keeps Fire Vulnerability at 5 stacks and **Fire Blast** goes out on cooldown. **Ice Lance** is in the build only because **Fingers of Frost** requires it: the list never casts it. It is the official simulator's own Frostfire build and list (its FFB preset) since 2026-11-20; our tuned list was 0.46% ahead with these talents, under the 0.5% bar. In a 3-minute raid fight: **Frostfire Bolt** 40 casts, **Fire Blast** 21, **Pyroblast** 13, **Scorch** 13, **Evocation** 1; **Frostfire Bolt** 40% of the damage, **Pyroblast** 23%, **Fire Blast** 17%, **Ignite** 14%, **Scorch** 6%. 781 DPS in a full raid, 10% behind the Fire page.
why: **Scorch** comes first: with **Improved Scorch** each one adds a stack of Fire Vulnerability, 3% more Fire damage from you for 30 seconds, up to 5, and **Frostfire Bolt** counts as Fire. The list casts it while the boss has fewer than 5 stacks or they have under 5 seconds left, and from 4 stacks on never twice in a row. Trinkets and the other cooldowns wait for the fifth stack.

**Pyroblast** at 3 stacks of **Heating Up**, never twice in a row: each crit of **Frostfire Bolt**, **Fire Blast** or **Scorch** takes 25% off your next Pyroblast's cast (the stacks last 20 seconds), and each **Fire Blast** that hits adds a stack of its own, so three stacks turn 6 seconds into 1.5. One full cast before the pull, timed to finish as the fight starts.

**Fire Blast** whenever it is ready, every 6 seconds with **Improved Fire Blast**, except while both charges of **Fingers of Frost** are up. A proc (15% on each chill; every **Frostfire Bolt** that lands is one) treats your next 2 spells as cast on a frozen target, where **Shatter** adds 50% crit chance. Holding the instant **Fire Blast** sends the first charge to a cast spell: a **Frostfire Bolt**, whose critical bonus **Ice Shards** doubles, unless a **Scorch** or **Pyroblast** is due; with one charge left, **Fire Blast** may take it. **Incineration** gives **Fire Blast** 10% crit.

**Frostfire Bolt** fills the rest: 2.5 seconds with **Accelerant**, 370 mana less **Frost Channeling**'s 15%, **Critical Mass**'s 6% crit and **Ice Shards**' doubled critical bonus; each crit adds **Ignite**, a **Heating Up** stack and **Master of Elements**' refund. Its 40% slow is the chill that rolls for **Fingers of Frost**.
**Ice Lance** has no line: the talent is the point **Fingers of Frost** requires, and the charges go to your Fire and Frostfire spells.

**Fire Power** adds 3% Fire damage per Fire effect of yours on the target, up to 12%: Fire Vulnerability, **Ignite** and **Pyroblast**'s burn count; **Frostfire Bolt**'s own burn, a mixed school, does not.

Mana: **Evocation** when your mana falls below a **Pyroblast**'s 440, channelled back to 99%; its 8-minute cooldown makes it once a fight, and even with the raid's mana buffs the simulator channels it in every 3-minute fight. The rest comes with the cooldowns (two mana potions, your Mana Ruby from **Conjure Mana Ruby**, a Demonic Rune) and from **Master of Elements**: its one point refunds 10% of a spell's base cost on each Fire or Frost crit.
caveats: Fire Vulnerability is yours alone: in Forever it raises the Fire damage you deal (in Classic, everyone's), so another mage's **Scorch** does not hold your stacks; the simulator's raid debuffs bring none.
**Fingers of Frost** charges go to your next 2 spells, whatever they are.
Moving: **Fire Blast** is your only instant here; a 1.5-second **Scorch** or a 3-stack **Pyroblast** fits a short stop. Packs: **Flamestrike** and **Blizzard**; the simulator fights one boss.

**Frostfire Bolt** is new in Forever: its numbers are the simulator's model, not measured in game. Against Fire resistance it keeps its damage (the lower of the target's Fire and Frost resistance counts), while **Fire Blast**, **Scorch** and **Pyroblast** lose some.
The setting: a full raid, every raid buff and debuff, **Mage Armor** on.
diverge: The list has no end-of-fight rule: in the last 3 seconds a **Frostfire Bolt** (2.5 seconds plus its flight) may land after the boss dies; **Fire Blast** if it is ready, else **Scorch**.
Out of mana with **Evocation** spent: **Scorch** (150 mana, half a **Frostfire Bolt**) keeps Fire Vulnerability and **Heating Up** going until a potion or your gem is back.
